Section 1: Basic Computer Organisation (Questions 1 to 20)

Q1. What does CPU stand for?

A) Central Processing Unit ✅ B) Computer Personal Unit C) Central Program Unit D) Central Processing Utility

Q2. Which of the following is a primary memory device?

A) Hard Disk B) RAM ✅ C) Pen Drive D) CD-ROM

Q3. What is the full form of ROM?

A) Read Only Memory ✅ B) Random Only Memory C) Read Operate Memory D) Random Operate Memory

Q4. Which type of memory is volatile?

A) ROM B) Hard Disk C) RAM ✅ D) DVD

Q5. What is the smallest unit of memory?

A) Byte B) Bit ✅ C) KB D) MB

Q6. 1 Kilobyte (KB) is equal to:

A) 100 bytes B) 1024 bytes ✅ C) 1024 bits D) 1000 bits

Q7. Which of the following is a secondary storage device?

A) RAM B) ROM C) Hard Disk ✅ D) Cache Memory

Q8. What is the function of Cache Memory?

A) Permanent storage B) Storing frequently accessed data for faster access ✅ C) Storing boot instructions D) Input/Output operations

Q9. 1 Terabyte (TB) is equal to:

A) 1024 GB ✅ B) 1000 GB C) 1024 MB D) 1024 KB

Q10. Which of the following is an input device?

A) Monitor B) Printer C) Keyboard ✅ D) Speaker

Q11. Which of the following is an output device?

A) Mouse B) Scanner C) Monitor ✅ D) Microphone

Q12. What is the full form of ALU?

A) Arithmetic Logic Unit ✅ B) Arithmetic Logical Unit C) Array Logic Unit D) Advanced Logic Unit

Q13. Which component of CPU performs arithmetic operations?

A) CU B) ALU ✅ C) MU D) Register

Q14. What is the function of the Control Unit (CU)?

A) Performs calculations B) Stores data C) Directs and coordinates operations ✅ D) Input/output operations

Q15. Which of the following memory is fastest?

A) RAM B) Hard Disk C) Cache Memory ✅ D) ROM

Q16. 1 Petabyte (PB) is equal to:

A) 1024 TB ✅ B) 1000 TB C) 1024 GB D) 1024 MB

Q17. What type of memory is used for storing BIOS?

A) RAM B) ROM ✅ C) Hard Disk D) Cache

Q18. Which of the following is NOT a unit of memory?

A) Byte B) KB C) Hertz ✅ D) GB

Q19. The CPU consists of:

A) ALU and Registers B) ALU and CU ✅ C) CU and Registers D) ALU, CU and Memory

Q20. What is the function of the system bus?

A) Connects CPU to peripherals B) Transfers data between components ✅ C) Stores data D) Performs calculations

A) Mainframe Computer B) Supercomputer ✅ C) Mini Computer D) Personal Computer

Q27. Which type of computer is used in scientific research?

A) Mainframe B) Supercomputer ✅ C) Mini Computer D) Microcomputer

Q28. IBM Z series is an example of which type of computer?

A) Supercomputer B) Mainframe Computer ✅ C) Mini Computer D) Microcomputer

Section 3: Concepts of Software (Questions 31 to 55)

Q31. What is software?

A) Physical components of a computer B) A set of instructions/programs ✅ C) Input/output devices D) Memory storage

Q32. Which of the following is system software?

A) MS Word B) Operating System ✅ C) Photoshop D) Tally

Q33. What is the function of an operating system?

A) Compile programs B) Manage hardware and software resources ✅ C) Create documents D) Browse the internet

Q34. Which of the following is an example of application software?

A) Windows 10 B) Linux C) Microsoft Word ✅ D) BIOS

Q35. What is a compiler?

A) Converts high-level language to machine code ✅ B) Executes programs line by line C) Manages files D) Provides user interface

Q36. What is an interpreter?

A) Converts high-level code to machine code line by line ✅ B) Converts entire program at once C) Combines object files D) Loads programs into memory

Q37. What is the difference between a compiler and an interpreter?

A) Compiler translates all at once, interpreter translates line by line ✅ B) Interpreter translates all at once, compiler translates line by line C) Both work the same D) Compiler is used for all languages

Q38. What is a linker?

A) Converts source code to object code B) Combines object files into executable ✅ C) Loads program into memory D) Manages files

Q39. What is the function of a loader?

A) Converts source code to object code B) Combines object files C) Loads program into memory for execution ✅ D) Provides user interface

Q40. Which type of OS allows multiple users to work simultaneously?

A) Single-user OS B) Multi-user OS ✅ C) Real-time OS D) Embedded OS

Q41. Which type of OS allows multiple programs to run simultaneously?

A) Single-user B) Multiprogramming OS ✅ C) Single-tasking D) Batch OS

Q42. What is multiprocessing?

A) Running multiple programs on one CPU B) Using multiple CPUs for processing ✅ C) Running one program at a time D) Using multiple monitors

Q43. What is time-sharing?

A) CPU time divided among multiple users ✅ B) Multiple CPUs used simultaneously C) One user at a time D) Batch processing

Q44. What is GUI?

A) Graphical User Interface ✅ B) General User Interface C) Graphic Utility Interface D) General Utility Interface

Q45. What is CUI?

A) Character User Interface ✅ B) Command User Interface C) Character Utility Interface D) Computer User Interface

Q46. Which of the following is a Linux command to list files?

A) `dir` B) `ls` ✅ C) `list` D) `show`

Q47. Which command is used to change directory in Linux?

A) `cd` ✅ B) `chdir` C) `md` D) `rd`

Q48. Which command is used to create a new directory in Linux?

A) `mkdir` ✅ B) `md` C) `cr` D) `newdir`

Q49. What is utility software?

A) Software that manages computer resources B) Software that performs specific maintenance tasks ✅ C) Software that creates documents D) Software that manages network

Q50. Which of the following is an example of utility software?

A) Windows 10 B) Microsoft Word C) Antivirus ✅ D) Google Chrome

Q51. What is an assembler?

A) Converts assembly language to machine code ✅ B) Converts high-level language to machine code C) Executes programs D) Manages memory

Q52. Which of the following is a single-user operating system?

A) Windows 10 ✅ B) Linux (server) C) UNIX D) Windows Server

Q53. Which type of operating system is Windows 10?

A) Single-user, Single-tasking B) Single-user, Multi-tasking ✅ C) Multi-user, Single-tasking D) Multi-user, Multi-tasking

Q54. Which of the following is NOT a translator?

A) Compiler B) Interpreter C) Assembler D) Loader ✅

Q55. What is the purpose of system software?

A) To help users do specific tasks B) To run and manage the computer hardware ✅ C) To create documents D) To browse the internet

Q56. What is the base of the binary number system?

A) 8 B) 2 ✅ C) 10 D) 16

Q57. What is the base of the octal number system?

A) 2 B) 8 ✅ C) 10 D) 16

Q58. What is the base of the decimal number system?

A) 2 B) 8 C) 10 ✅ D) 16

Q59. What is the base of the hexadecimal number system?

A) 8 B) 10 C) 16 ✅ D) 2

Q60. Convert binary 1010 to decimal.

A) 8 B) 10 ✅ C) 12 D) 5

Q61. Convert decimal 15 to binary.

A) 1000 B) 1111 ✅ C) 1100 D) 1010

Q62. Convert octal 17 to decimal.

A) 15 ✅ B) 17 C) 13 D) 19

Q63. Convert decimal 25 to octal.

A) 31 ✅ B) 30 C) 32 D) 33

Q64. Convert hexadecimal A to decimal.

A) 8 B) 10 ✅ C) 11 D) 12

Q65. Convert decimal 12 to hexadecimal.

A) A B) B C) C ✅ D) D

Q66. What is BCD code?

A) Binary Coded Decimal ✅ B) Basic Coded Decimal C) Binary Converted Decimal D) Byte Coded Decimal

Q67. What is the BCD representation of decimal 15?

A) 0001 0101 ✅ B) 1111 C) 1000 1000 D) 1111 1111

Q68. What is Grey code?

A) Weighted code B) Non-weighted code ✅ C) Binary code D) BCD code

Q69. What is Excess-3 code?

A) Weighted code B) Non-weighted code ✅ C) Binary code D) BCD code

Q70. What is ASCII?

A) American Standard Code for Information Interchange ✅ B) American System Code for Information Interchange C) Advanced Standard Code for Information Interchange D) American Standard Character for Information Interchange

Q71. How many characters can ASCII represent?

A) 128 ✅ B) 64 C) 256 D) 512

Q72. What is ISCII?

A) Indian Standard Code for Information Interchange ✅ B) Indian System Code for Information Interchange C) International Standard Code for Information Interchange D) Indian Standard Character for Information Interchange

Q73. What is Unicode?

A) An encoding scheme for all languages ✅ B) An encoding scheme for English only C) A hardware component D) A type of memory

Q74. What is 1's complement of binary 1010?

A) 0101 ✅ B) 1010 C) 1111 D) 0000

Q75. What is 2's complement of binary 1010?

A) 0101 B) 0110 ✅ (1's complement + 1 = 0101 + 1 = 0110) C) 1111 D) 0000

Q76. Which of the following is a weighted code?

A) Grey Code B) Excess-3 C) BCD ✅ D) ASCII

Q77. Convert binary 1111 to hexadecimal.

A) F ✅ B) 15 C) E D) 1F

Q78. Convert hexadecimal 1A to decimal.

A) 16 B) 26 ✅ C) 20 D) 18

Q79. Convert octal 12 to binary.

A) 1010 B) 1110 C) 1010 D) 001010 ✅ (1→001, 2→010 → 001010)

Actually, octal 1 = 001, 2 = 010 → 001010. So D is correct.

Q80. Which encoding scheme is used for all modern operating systems?

A) ASCII B) ISCII C) Unicode ✅ D) BCD
